question: Can the official phased panel provide population- and recent-kinship-disjoint source blocks with rare-allele support outside the NatWGS-128 ascertainment panel?

ibd_contract.threshold_source: IBD_relatedness relatedness_v1.py uses total IBD divided by four genome lengths for kinship and names 0 or 10 cM as typical max-segment filters; pedigree expectations define the three kinship thresholds.
ibd_contract.primary_block_policy: max_segment_cm>=10 and kinship>=0.04419417382415922, unioned with exact Ancestry x Source x Population strata

gates.name: input_and_provenance_contract
gates.pass_rule: Exactly 22 autosomes have matching Refined-IBD files, logs and genetic maps; every log reports the frozen version, 3,685 samples, length=2 and LOD=3; every segment has nine valid fields and satisfies those floors.

gates.name: identity_and_population_coverage_contract
gates.pass_rule: The phased panel, resolved-strata table and IBD universe contain the same 3,685 unique identifiers; all 128 NatWGS discovery samples are population-interpretable Native-American samples; 3,675 panel samples have population metadata and the 10 documented unmatched samples are retained for identity and IBD accounting but excluded from ancestry-specific interpretation.

gates.name: rare_bridge_reproduction
gates.pass_rule: The frozen M27B definition reproduces exactly 954 direct phase-bridge sites; their sorted private key-plus-orientation list receives a SHA-256 digest but is not published.

gates.name: three_role_block_feasibility
gates.pass_rule: Under the primary recent-kinship policy, AFR, EUR and NAM each retain at least three Source x Population x kinship blocks; raw >=2 cM connected components are reported only as a percolation diagnostic and are not interpreted as pedigrees.

gates.name: external_native_american_rare_support
gates.pass_rule: At least one of the 954 frozen alleles is carried in at least two discovery blocks and at least two non-NatWGS Native-American blocks under the primary policy. This proves structural transfer only, not adequate power.

gates.name: baseline_channel_separation
gates.pass_rule: The exact overlap between the 954 keys and the frozen Gnomix baseline is measured. Any compatible future baseline must exclude all overlapping keys before simulation; this audit does not construct that baseline.

stop_rules: Never use a raw any-segment >=2 cM connected component as a pedigree certificate.
Never place NatWGS-128 discovery samples in SOURCE_VALID or SOURCE_TEST for this frozen 954-site list.
Never choose a kinship or segment threshold after observing rare-site support.
Never orient or select rare alleles using SOURCE_VALID or SOURCE_TEST.
Never treat sites, segments, individuals or demes as independent replicates.
Do not simulate, run LAI, train a model, inspect a future SOURCE_TEST genotype partition or execute KING in M27E.
If E4 fails under the primary policy, do not rescue it by selecting a diagnostic sensitivity.
If a future common baseline contains any target rare key, exclude it or preregister a separate shared-marker ablation before comparing incremental value.

amendments.reason: The frozen M27D strata artifact resolves all 3,685 panel identities but documents population metadata for 3,675; ten samples are unmatched. Requiring invented population labels would violate the fail-closed identity policy.
amendments.delta: Use the hash-pinned M27D resolved-strata artifact; keep all samples in identity/IBD accounting and exclude only the ten documented unmatched samples from ancestry-specific summaries. No IBD, rare-allele or gate threshold changed.
